claims.value: Gnptg-KO MEF <n> lysosomal fraction (light) / WT MEF <n> lysosomal fraction (heavy), n = replicate 1-3
claims.evidence: PRIDE: 'MEF cells isolated from three Gnptgko and three wild-type mice ... Wild type MEF and Gnptgko cells were labelled with heavy and light SILAC amino acids'. Raw files fall in three replicate series: Melanie1_*, Melanie2_*, Rep3Melanie_151214_* (PD input folder 'MEF gamma Replikat 3'); PD workflow name '3 Replicates MEF gamma'. Blocks: Gnptg-KO MEF 1 rows 1-10; WT MEF 1 rows 11-20; Gnptg-KO MEF 2 rows 21-30; WT MEF 2 rows 31-40; Gnptg-KO MEF 3 rows 41-50; WT MEF 3 rows 51-60.

claims.value: SILAC light (Gnptg knockout) / SILAC heavy (wild type)
claims.evidence: Explicit: PRIDE protocol 'Wild type MEF and Gnptgko cells were labelled with heavy and light SILAC amino acids, respectively'; same convention as the sister deposit PXD007546, whose deposited MaxQuant ratios were checked (Arsb/Hexb/Glb1 WT>KO). Multiplexing verified (rule 14): msf quantification method 'SILAC 2plex (Arg10, Lys8)', channels Light/Heavy. A direct ratio check on this deposit's 6 GB pdResult was attempted but timed out (see limitations).

claims.value: 1-10 = gel slice number from the file-name suffix / SDS PAGE
claims.evidence: PRIDE: lysosomal eluates 'separated by SDS-PAGE ... in-gel digested'; each replicate has 10 raw files suffixed _1.._10 (_01.._10 for replicate 3), all combined in one PD search; fraction id = suffix (slice order not separately documented).
PRIDE: three Gnptgko and three wild-type MEF; abstract 'fibroblasts of wild-type and Gnptg ko mice'.

Three KO and three WT mice; three replicate series (Melanie1, Melanie2, Rep3); numbered 1..3 per factor-value group (spec README.adoc:330, rule 3). Pairing of one KO + one WT line per series is inferred (see limitations).
PRIDE organisms NEWT:10090; msf Mascot taxonomy Mus musculus.
MEF = mouse embryonic fibroblasts (dmm2020 refers to 'embryonic fibroblasts from Gnptgko mice (Di Lorenzo et al., 2018)'). Embryonic day not available.
PRIDE 'MEF cells'; PRIDE organismParts CL:0000057 Fibroblast; CL:2000042 embryonic fibroblast.
Primary cultured MEF; the measured sample is their lysosomal fraction (characteristics[cellular component]).

PRIDE title 'LC-MS/MS analysis of soluble lysosomal enzymes'; protocol: 'isolation of lysosomal fractions with magnetic beads ... (Markmann et al, 2015)'; GO:0005764. Biochemical fraction recorded as a characteristic (rule 16); custom column per spec 'Extending Templates'.
Abstract: Gnptg ko mice 'mimicking the lysosomal storage disorder mucolipidosis III'; MONDO:0009652; WT rows 'normal'.
dmm2020 Methods: 'Gnptgko (C57Bl/6) ... mice have been described previously (... Di Lorenzo et al., 2018)'.

Raw header 'LTQ Orbitrap Velos MS' in Melanie1_1, Melanie2_1 and Rep3Melanie_151214_01 (one per replicate series); PRIDE instruments also lists generic 'LTQ Orbitrap', not supported by the headers; protocol text names Orbitrap Velos.

PRIDE says 'in-gel digested as described previously (Mann et al, 2007)' without naming the enzyme; the deposited msf Mascot node uses Enzyme 'Trypsin' (CleavageSites KR, inhibitor P; second pass semiTrypsin), and the Mann/Shevchenko 2007 in-gel protocol is a trypsin digest.

limitations: Paper full text (Di Lorenzo et al. 2018, MCP) not reachable (not OA subset; PDF HTTP 403, not bypassed); only the abstract was read. Design from the PRIDE protocol and the deposited PD msf/pdResult.

Channel map is from the explicit PRIDE statement (WT heavy, KO light). A data cross-check on this deposit's 6 GB pdResult (TargetProteins.Ratios, no accession index) was attempted over HTTP range reads and timed out twice; the same convention was verified against the sister deposit PXD007546's MaxQuant ratios.
Replicate pairing: three KO and three WT mice and three replicate series; one distinct KO + WT pair per series is inferred, not stated.
Gel-slice order is taken from the file-name suffix _1.._10; not separately documented.

Two-pass search: primary Mascot pass (Trypsin, 8 ppm, Propionamide fixed) is encoded; the second semiTrypsin pass on unmatched spectra (10 ppm, Propionamide variable, 1 missed cleavage -- the values quoted in the PRIDE protocol) cannot be expressed in the same row.
PRIDE lists 'LTQ Orbitrap' in addition to 'LTQ Orbitrap Velos'; the three raw headers checked (one per series) all say LTQ Orbitrap Velos.
Embryonic day, sex and passage number of the MEF lines not available. Strain C57BL/6 from the same lab's 2020 paper on the Gnptgko line.
Not a duplicate of PXD007546: no raw overlap (distinct names, sizes, SHA-1). Whether the same MEF lines were used in both arms is not stated, so source names are not shared.
